text.tspan: The difference is when your mistakes are found.
A typo or a type mistake stops you HERE — before the program has run, and before any user sees it.
The same mistake is not found until the line actually runs — which may be in front of a user.
Compiling buys safety and costs a step. Interpreting buys speed of trying things and costs late surprises. Neither is the winner.
